title: One neo4j instance serving multiple projects
description:
To not have to run multiple neo4j instances, it must be possible to always query/create/delete etc all nodes by "projectId" . Its akin to having a database with 1 table with the same types, where there's a foreign key "projectId" that indexes all values in that table - and it would be possible to split that table into multiple ones where each would be a reference to that "projectId", but to make infrastructure better we stick to the 1 table approach. The same idea should be used here.
Whenever querying, it should be possible to query multiple projects at once (so providing a list of "projecIds" - if empty -> query all) and return results from all.

features.title: Core: Add projectId to GraphService for multi-tenancy
features.description: Update `graph_service.py` to support multi-tenancy. All node creation, update, deletion, and query methods must be modified to operate within the scope of one or more `projectIds`. When creating nodes, a `projectId` property must be added. When querying, a list of `projectIds` should be used for filtering. An empty list of `projectIds` should mean querying across all projects.

features.title: API: Add projectId filtering to Area and Entity endpoints
features.description: Update the `routers/areas.py` to support multi-tenancy. The endpoints for listing, creating, and querying Areas and Entities must accept a `projectIds` query parameter. This parameter will be passed down to the `GraphService` to ensure that operations are scoped to the correct project(s).

features.title: API: Add projectId filtering to Blueprint endpoints
features.description: Update the `routers/blueprints.py` to support multi-tenancy. The CRUD endpoints for Blueprints must accept a `projectIds` query parameter. This will be passed to the `GraphService` to ensure project-scoped operations.

features.title: Refactor: Update Agent Tools for multi-tenancy
features.description: Update `agent_tools.py` to support multi-tenancy. All functions that interact with the `GraphService` must be updated to accept `projectIds` and pass them down to the service layer. This ensures that the high-level agent-facing tools are project-aware.

features.title: Tests: Update tests for multi-tenancy
features.description: Update all existing tests in `tests/scenarios/` to be compatible with the new multi-tenancy feature. This involves providing a `projectId` when creating test data and using `projectIds` when querying. Add assertions to verify that data from one project is not visible when querying another.
